Fields.Comment: Primary key - unique application version status value identifier
Foreign key - reference to Organizations.Id for organization-specific statuses
Display name of the application version status
Color code in hex format (e.g., #FF5733) for UI display
Order for displaying status values in lists
Whether this is the default status for new application versions
Whether this status indicates the version has been released
Optional foreign key - reference to TaskStatusValues.Id for linked task workflow
Date and time when status value was created

Relationships.Name: ApplicationVersionStatusOrganization
Relationships.Description: Application version status belongs to an Organization

Relationships.Name: ApplicationVersionStatusTaskStatus
Relationships.Description: Optional link to a task status in the same organization
